newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline tracks crude drop.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline tracks crude drop.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Thursday with a late futures slump taking its toll on light ends.
Gasoline prices were hit by the selloff futures, with Nov swaps off $4 at $220/$221 and Eurograde barges at $224/$227.
Naphtha prices lost about $1.50 to $2, also tracking crude's declines and perceptions of near-term availability.
Gas oil gained on stronger futures but feeble end user interest undermined heating oil cargo premiums.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil was steady for much of the day but falling futures then dampened sentiment.
